name: Dual-Use Regulation
evidence_rating: thin: annual Commission implementation reports with licensing and trade statistics; no evaluation of effects
summary: The recast export-control regime applies since September 2021. The Commission's annual implementation reports put dual-use exports at about 2.7% of EU exports (EUR 128 billion in 2020) and describe licensing activity, but licensing decisions are not public and no evaluation of the Regulation's effects exists.

indicators.objective: No monitoring indicators set in the proposal; assessed through the Commission's reports listed below

indicators.evidence: Dual-use exports about 2.7% of EU exports (EUR 128 billion, 2020); latest report covers 2024.

literature.headline: Aggregated EU and Member State export control data for 2024; aims to increase transparency of licensing
literature.summary_plain: The Commission publishes yearly figures on dual-use export licensing, but they describe activity, not effects.
